comment: SQDT fit of the 7Li s and p series; every dataset of energies from the ground state has its own ionization threshold (free offset), so the quantum defects only describe binding energies and intervals and are used with the threshold of rydstate.

The nd and nf models are not fitted: the measured d and f levels (Sautenkov 2016, Zelener 2016, Saakyan 2016, MOT spectroscopy at n = 38-48 with 30-90 MHz) give delta_0 only to +-4.5e-4 (delta_0 = 0.002 and 0.0003), far less precise than the present models.

n_min: the data start at n = 18 (p) and 22 (s); the models are used from n = 7, just above the levels of Radziemski 1995 (FTS, n <= 6, not fitted), which they describe within 0.5 GHz (5s, 6s) and 4 GHz (6p), while the NIST levels at n = 8-17 (Kelly 1987 compilation, not critically evaluated) lie 8-100 GHz off the fit. orders: 2 coefficients; a third one lowers chi2 (mostly through the Goy 1986 two-photon p lines), but gives delta_4 = 5 for np, and the extrapolation misses 6p of Radziemski 1995 by 100 GHz.
